title: Alexander Badlam
vital_facts: Married Mary Ann Brannan 1833; At least three children
Ordained Seventy and called to First Quorum of Seventy 1834
Council of the Fifty 1841; Dropped 1845; recalled in 1851; dropped 1868
Migrated west with saints but ended up in San Francisco
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
